metadata.title: ScrollBooker — Video-First Booking for Beauty
metadata.description: ScrollBooker is the social network you book from: video feed, follows, likes, comments, video reviews — plus calendar, services, products, and staff, fully managed in one place.

getStarted.title: Here's exactly what's next
getStarted.subtitle: The process takes about 10 minutes. You can stop anytime and pick up later — nothing gets lost.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.description: Email, password, and a username for your business.

steps.title: Add your business details
steps.description: Profile, address, and a photo gallery — what a client sees when they discover you.

steps.title: Set up your offering
steps.description: The services you offer, your working hours, and, if it applies, your staff.

steps.title: Wait for approval
steps.description: We quickly review your profile, then you're visible in the app — ready for bookings.

getStarted.approvalNote: The last step needs a manual approval from the ScrollBooker team — usually quick, not instant.

announcementBar.message: We're launching ScrollBooker — the first businesses to sign up get priority access, before the market fills up.

hero.badge: The first Video-First Booking platform for Beauty
hero.subtitle: Clients follow your business, like and share your content, comment — and book instantly, straight from the video, without leaving the feed. Alongside the community that builds around you, you get a fully managed calendar, services, products, and staff.
hero.imageAlt: The ScrollBooker feed — video discovery, with likes, comments, and an instant booking button

socialContrast.kicker: Why it's not just another booking app
socialContrast.title: The engagement of a social network, with instant booking built in
oldWay: A static list of businesses, sorted or filtered
You search actively, only when you already need a booking
Reviews = text and a score, that's it
No reason to ever open the app between bookings
newWay: A vertical video feed, like TikTok — you discover organically, not just search
You follow the businesses you like, see their new content in the feed
Likes, comments, shares — a real community forms
Reviews are video clips, not just stars — real proof that circulates as organic advertising for you
Instant booking, straight from the video, without leaving the app

features.title: Everything you need to grow, in a single app

items.title: A community, not just customers
items.description: Likes, comments, shares, followers — every interaction puts you in front of more and more new people, just like on any social network.

items.title: Online booking, 24/7
items.description: Clients book straight from the video, anytime, without phone calls or messages. Your calendar updates automatically, in real time.

items.title: Complete management
items.description: Calendar, services, products, working hours, and staff — all in one panel, whether you work solo or with a team.

items.title: Video reviews = free advertising
items.description: Your happy clients post their own video reviews — real content that circulates in other people's feeds and brings you new clients, at no cost.

profileShowcase.title: Your profile becomes a community, not just a list of services
profileShowcase.subtitle: Just like on any social network — except here you can also book directly, without switching apps.
profileShowcase.imageAlt: A business profile on ScrollBooker, with followers, reviews, and a video portfolio

items.title: Followers, not just past clients
items.description: Anyone who likes your work can follow you — they see your new content first, even before they have a booking planned.

items.title: A video portfolio, not static photos
items.description: Every post you make stays on your profile — new clients see exactly what you can do, not just a description.

items.title: Reviews you can see, not just read
items.description: Your score and review count show up right on your profile, next to the content that earned them.

items.title: Your business link, clearly visible
items.description: If you're staff, your profile shows exactly which business you work at — clients book with you, knowing exactly where.

howItWorks.title: From sign-up to your first booking
howItWorks.clientsTitle: Book just as easily — straight from a video
howItWorks.bookingFlowImageAlt: Booking flow straight from a video post: see a look in the feed, pick the service, pick the time, confirm the booking

steps.title: You sign up
steps.description: Fill in your business details — it takes a few minutes, straight from the browser, no app install needed.

steps.title: You set up your profile
steps.description: Add a photo gallery, your services and products, your working hours, and, if it applies, your staff.

steps.title: You get bookings
steps.description: Once approved, your profile becomes visible in the app — clients discover you and book directly.

adminShowcase.title: Not just bookings — your whole business, managed
adminShowcase.subtitle: Whether you work solo or with a full team, ScrollBooker gives you every tool you need day to day, not just the storefront your clients see.
adminShowcase.imageAlt: A modern salon interior, with a management device at the front desk

items.title: Calendar
items.description: A calendar of its own per staff member, or a single one if you work solo — always in sync.

items.title: Services & hours
items.description: Set your services, their duration, and your working hours.

items.title: Products
items.description: Manage the products/packages you sell to clients.

items.title: Staff
items.description: Invite your team into the app — each with their own calendar and their own bookings.

items.title: Statistics
items.description: See at a glance how your business is growing over time.

mobileApps.title: Just a little longer — and we'll be in your pocket too
mobileApps.subtitle: The native ScrollBooker experience, with a full-screen video feed, is coming soon to iOS and Android. Until then, everything you need to get your business ready already works, right here, on the web.

cta.title: Be ready before the wave hits, not after
cta.subtitle: The earlier your profile is set up, the more visibility you get once clients start arriving in the app — and the less competition for that same attention. Signing up takes a few minutes and costs nothing.
